checked_obligation: Verify that ten copies of 21 form a legal list with no subset sum in [191,209], thereby defeating Player 2 when N=9.
reason: The list is legal because each entry is the positive integer 21≤25 and its total is 210≥200. Every subset sum is 21k for some integer 0≤k≤10. The neighboring values around 200 are 189 and 210, so no subset sum lies in [191,209]; the minimum distance from 200 is therefore 10. Thus Player 2 cannot win for N=9 on this list. The supplied group-theoretic rules are inapplicable and are not used.
